text:
[Council File 26-1393; CD 2]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2024-1839, located at 13510 West Kittridge Street, westerly of Greenbush Avenue.
Recommendation for Council action: APPROVE the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2024-1839, located at 13510 West Kittridge Street, westerly of Greenbush Avenue and accompanying Subdivision Improvement Agreement and Contract with security documents.
Owner: David Papoyan and Mariam Manukyan; Surveyor: Mohamad A. Molai
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Engineer reports that the subdivider has paid a fee of $9,064 for the processing of this final parcel map pursuant to Section 19.02(B)(3) of the Los Angeles Municipal Code. No additional City funds are needed.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
